description: Validates a software-boundary UI Model has been generated (or explicitly recorded as not applicable) from its use-case model, preserving the existing UIModel/UIModelEntry/Aggregation structure and stable UME identities

checks.description: A ui-model.json must exist for every software boundary in scope, even if its entries array is empty
checks.remediation: Run ui-generatemodel against the target boundary's use-case model; for non-software boundaries or software boundaries with no UI-worthy use cases, still write a minimal model with entries: [] and a generation_note, never omit the file entirely

checks.description: A non-software or unknown-typed boundary's ui-model.json must have an empty entries array
checks.remediation: UI may only exist in explicitly software-typed boundaries (R-011, contract Section 2.2) — this is the single hardest line this skill must never cross

checks.description: Every produced UIModelEntry (where boundary_ref is present) must reference a software-typed boundary
checks.remediation: Confirm every entry's boundary_ref resolves to a boundary whose declared boundary_type is software, per contract Section 6

checks.description: Every entry must retain the existing D-02 required fields (entry_id, ui_concept_name, domain_entity_refs, aggregation_description), unchanged in shape
checks.remediation: The existing UIModel/UIModelEntry/Aggregation schema from D-02 (PRJ-06) is never restructured or had fields removed — only additive fields (boundary_ref, source_use_case_refs, generation_note) may be introduced

checks.description: A model with zero entries must carry a generation_note explaining why
checks.remediation: An empty entries array must always be accompanied by an explicit generation_note — never a silent, unexplained absence of UI content

checks.description: Entries' domain_entity_refs should be resolvable against the boundary's actual domain-model.md content, not merely well-formed IDs
checks.remediation: Confirm every entity reference actually appears in the cited boundary's domain-model.md — do not trust a use-case script's entity citation without checking, per the manifest-source-disagreement discipline established in T01

checks.description: Every ui-model.md must include a changelog section
checks.remediation: Per D-02's existing Business Rule and R-610, every UIModel includes an in-document changelog, even at first generation

checks.description: UI Model Entry IDs should follow the existing UME-[###] convention
checks.remediation: Use the existing UME-[###] zero-padded 3-digit format from ui-prototyping-conventions.md — unchanged by this skill
